name: LIFE, APPARENTLY.
description: Practical knowledge for everyday life — the useful things people are often expected to know without anyone clearly teaching them.

config.mission: Help people understand and handle the practical parts of everyday life. Make it useful enough to save, share, or remember because it makes real life easier.
config.brand_promise: Practical information that makes everyday life easier.
config.writing_rule: Explain useful things like a smart friend who figured something out and thought you should know too.
config.visual_direction: Modern editorial, practical reference guide, strong typography, high contrast, lime annotation accents, useful whitespace, clean mobile readability. No crown or primary handwriting typography.
config.tagline: Stuff you're somehow supposed to know.
config.short_bio:
Practical stuff for money, home, food, work & everyday life.
Stuff you're somehow supposed to know.
config.voice: Practical, conversational, intelligent without sounding academic, confident without pretending to know everything. Lightly witty only when natural. Specific, useful, calm and human.
config.tone: Useful before clever. Explain plainly, acknowledge nuance, and never shame the reader for not knowing a skill.
config.audience: People trying to make everyday life easier and understand practical things they were never clearly taught.
config.cta_rules: Invite a useful save or a practical next step naturally. Never use engagement bait or fake urgency.

editorial.description: Practical, conversational, specific, calm and human. Intelligent without academic language; lightly dry or witty only when natural. Give people something they can actually do. Never shame the reader or assume everyone learned the same skills. Avoid jargon, filler, forced slang, fake urgency and exaggerated promises.
editorial.reading_style: Plain conversational English, easy to scan, with specific examples when supported
hook_styles: A practical thing nobody explained clearly
editorial.cta_style: Natural and useful invitation to save or try the relevant action; no engagement bait
editorial.formatting_preferences: Useful before clever; short action headlines, concise explanations, practical examples, no unnecessary exclamation marks

moderation_rules: Escalate consequential financial, medical and legal advice
